{{Quote|I'll be glad when this is done. I feel as rough as old boots. Qail can make me a nice pot of ''shig'' when I get home, maybe with a splash of ''tihaar'' in it.|[[Mij Gilamar]]|<ref name="ImpCom" />}}
'''''Shig''''' was a [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Tea/Legends|tisane]], a beverage infusion made from any available [[Plant/Legends|herb]]. ''[[Behot]]'', a citrus-flavored herb, was a popular choice for making ''shig'',<ref name="TMPaC" /> and was often used as a natural relaxant.<ref name="TC" /> ''Shig'' brewed from the ''behot'' herbs possessed an amber [[Color/Legends|coloring]], and retained the plant's citrus flavor.<ref name="TLJ" /> Some Mandalorians enjoyed splicing their ''shig'' by adding a touch of ''[[Tihaar/Legends|tihaar]]'', a powerful [[Alcohol/Legends|alcoholic]] [[Spirit (alcohol)|spirit]] Mandalorians distilled from [[Fruit/Legends|fruit]].<ref name="ImpCom" />

While [[Reproduction/Legends|pregnant]] with her son [[Venku Skirata|Venku]], [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Etain Tur-Mukan]] found a cup of ''shig'' soothing to her [[Stomach/Legends|stomach]],<ref name="TC" /> and her [[Gai bal manda|adopted]] Mandalorian [[Parent/Legends|father]], [[Kal Skirata]], enjoyed a mug of ''shig'' to calm his nerves. [[Cantina/Legends|Cantinas]] along [[Chortav Meshurkaane]] in [[Keldabe/Legends|Keldabe]] sold mugs of ''shig'',<ref name="ImpCom" /> and the [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] anti-[[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] resistance fighters of [[Toprawa/Legends|Toprawa]] brewed their own ''shig'' from locally grown ''behot'' herbs by the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. While working with the resistance on Toprawa, the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] Knight-in-hiding [[Jax Pavan]] came to develop a taste for the hot beverage, and drank ''shig'' often during his time on the planet.<ref name="TLJ" />

==Behind the scenes==
''Shig'' was first introduced to the ''[[Star Wars]]'' universe in the [[2006]] ''[[Star Wars Insider]]'' article, ''[[The Mandalorians: People and Culture]]'', by [[Republic Commando|''Republic'' and ''Imperial Commando'' series]] [[Author/Legends|author]], [[Karen Traviss]].<ref name="TMPaC" /> ''Shig'' made its first full appearance a year later, in Traviss' [[2007]] novel, ''[[Republic Commando: True Colors]]''.<ref name="TC" /> The drink would appear again in Traviss' later novel, ''[[Imperial Commando: 501st]]'',<ref name="ImpCom" /> as well as [[Michael Reaves]] and [[Maya Kaathryn Bohnhoff]]'s [[2013]] novel, [[The Last Jedi (novel)|''The Last Jedi'']].<ref name="TLJ" />
